messages:
olivia_cs: Heads up — Zephyrus Labs flagged steady tail latency on their chat endpoint during peak (p95 ~ 410ms). Renewal Q in 6 weeks so want to be proactive with perf ops.

mike_se: Thanks — have their traffic profile? burstiness, avg seq len?

olivia_cs: Quick summary from onboarding metrics: 60% short queries (<64 tokens), 30% 64-256, 10% long. 2.1M requests/day, 7pm-9pm local spike.

jin_ml: That distribution looks quant-friendly. Suggest pilot an int8 quantized variant of the current model + routing rule routing small requests to quantized pool.

sam_zephyrus: Sounds good. Any risk to hallucination/quality? We can't degrade NPS.

eve_prod: Quality caution = important. Proposal: 2-stage canary. 1) internal perf run with parity prompts; 2) 2% live traffic canary for 48h with automatic rollback on quality or latency regressions.

mike_se: Implementation details: create a canary route: 
```json
{
  "route": "zephyrus.quant-canary",
  "traffic_split": 0.02,
  "model": "model-v3-int8",
  "fallback": "model-v3-fp16"
}
```
We can set sampling to prefer short queries.

jin_ml: We'll instrument eval hooks to compute BLEU/embedding-sim delta and a heuristic label-check for sensitive hallucination types. If embedding distance > 0.08 vs baseline on control set, trigger alert.

perf-bot: Canary created: zephyrus.quant-canary. Monitors: p50/p95 latency, token cost, embedding-sim delta. Alert threshold set: p95 > 20% from baseline OR embedding delta > 0.08 OR error rate > 0.5%.

olivia_cs: Great. Next steps for enablement: schedule a 30-min session with Zephyrus ops to review canary config and rollback plan. Sam — when's good?

sam_zephyrus: Tue 10am PT works for us. Also want a short doc we can share internally about what to expect.

mike_se: I'll draft a 1-pager: goals, metrics, rollback triggers, sample queries collection. Will drop in this thread by EOD.

jin_ml: For data capture, we'll enable prefix KV caching metrics and include per-request model variant tag so we can compute per-model latency & quality. Also recommend enabling trace sampling (1%) for full KV/latency traces.

eve_prod: Add renewal risk note: if canary shows >=10% cost savings w/out quality loss, push as renewal talking point. Ops should capture screenshots of Console dashboards for the account brief.

olivia_cs: Action items: @mike_se draft 1-pager; @jin_ml set up canary and eval hooks; @perf-bot keep watch; @sam_zephyrus confirm Tue 10am PT. We'll reconvene after 48h canary to decide model swap.

sam_zephyrus: Confirmed — see you Tue 10am PT. Appreciate the proactive plan :thumbsup:
